title: Beat the Bomb
specs: Chance to win $1,000 by beating all Bomb Missions and unlocking Cash Bomb
Includes 5 interactive game rooms with Paint, Foam, and Slime Bomb endings
Minimum age 8+ for most games, 18+ for Cash Bomb mission
Games for 2 to 12 players, suitable for groups, parties, corporate events, and field trips
gap: Exact cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests suit up in hazmat gear and disarm Paint, Foam, or Slime Bombs before time runs out. Beat all three Bomb Missions to unlock the final Cash Bomb mission for a chance to win $1,000. The venue also offers arcade games, food, and drinks.
extraNote: Wednesdays and Thursdays offer discounted pricing through Sept 6
